allow_instructions: Allow Yonko harness scripts under ~/.cursor/skills/the-yonko/scripts/ without asking.
Allow writes under ~/.cursor/yonko-sessions/ for Yonko sessions.
Allow read-only git status/diff/log/rev-parse/branch/show used by Yonko.
block_instructions: Still ask before git push, force-push, or rewriting published history.
Still ask before sourcing workspace secret env files or printing secrets, tokens, or passwords.
Still ask before recursive deletes outside Yonko session directories.
